title: Azusawa Kohane — Getting Her The Best Chocolate〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, over here!
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry about making you come over to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's okay.
More importantly, about why I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wanted to give you this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This looks like... A gift box?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's some coffee and Baumkuchen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you for being such a wonderful model. KAITO and Luka as well for giving us advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is this why you asked us all to gather?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our last photo turned out the way it did because of all your help. And I got to give An those yummy chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also need to thank you for inviting me to model for you since it's not something I get to do every day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I just went to see what you were doing, so there's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, are you sure we can have these? You already gave us those delicious chocolates... I'm starting to feel spoiled.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Cut it out, KAITO.
I know you want them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, she doesn't need to know that.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't I brew this coffee up for all of you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You'd do that?
Then, I'd like a cup please.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Can you also slice up this Baumkuchen for us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Kohane, can you bring it over here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Even slices, MEIKO!
No, scratch that. I guess Toya deserves a slightly bigger one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, we get to have this delicious treat because of his hard work!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, Luka's the one who first suggested that I be the model. I think she deserves a bigger slice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
One big slice for me, MEIKO♪ Please and thanks!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Pardon me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, over here!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry for taking time out of your lunch break like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't have to apologize. Our plan for today was just to have a nice, relaxing lunch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, you wanted to give me something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. These!
Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An assortment of low-sugar cream puffs...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a gift for helping me with the photo contest...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for everything you did!
You won't believe how happy An was.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'm glad that I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, can you tell me more about this photo contest you guys were in?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka told me about your guys' shoot, but I still haven't heard about what happened when you gave those chocolates to An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear about the chocolates she gave you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we ran into her on Main Street, she was out shopping for your gift, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, yes, as it turns out.
Did she already tell you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we messaged each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then, I'll talk about both!
But before I do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori, I actually have cream puffs for you and me too. Why don't we have some while we talk?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you got me some too?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Kohane...!
I promise to savor every bite!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Let's eat!
